bounds_method: Read-only RGBA alpha >=32 connected components, source pixel rectangles [left,top,right,bottom], right/bottom exclusive. Minor low-alpha fringes can extend beyond bounds. Add 1-2 pixels padding where available.
anchor_notes: Requested cell-local bottom contact centered at 80% of height was not enforced by generation. Use individual ROI bottom center as an initial drawing anchor, then visually tune contact versus shadow. Exact physical foot/base anchor not measured.

buildings.notes: Equal 4x4 cropping can clip lower-row sprites and some horizontal bounds. Use custom ROIs. All sixteen catalog subjects present. Fort bounds include its complete highest tower and lowest foundation. Some generated buildings include small bases and vegetation despite no-ground-tile prompt.

resources.notes: Eight requested subjects present, clear distinct silhouettes and transparent surrounding pixels.

units.notes: 32 upright full-body subjects present. Facing directions are approximate; adjacent diagonal directions can look similar. Archer and knight sprite extents cross the equal row boundary. Custom ROIs preserve complete bodies.
